parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity/expression; third-gender recognition and progressive court doctrine exist, but no documented visitor-facing state restriction (no facility bans, no border/custody exposure, no police targeting of visitors documented). The main exposures are societal: frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities, deep stigma, rising anti-LGBT rhetoric including death threats after 2026 leader controversy — tier-3 hostility without a documented strong recourse record. Thin data on visitor-specific incidents; nothing resolves toward state threat. Climate is mixed-but-protective on paper with weak implementation, placing it in the upper Elevated band: safer than hostile-criminalising states, below jurisdictions with both acceptance and working protections.
